text: Grandma, what was life like when you were young?
It was very different, Nam. We didn't have many modern conveniences like we do now.
No, we didn't. We used to listen to the radio or play traditional games outdoors.
We walked to school, and our classrooms were very simple. We used chalk and slate instead of pens and paper.
It sounds like a tough life.
It was harder in some ways, but we were very happy. People were closer to each other.
